text: Acid casein will not dissolve in water. Adding alkali takes the pH back up from 4.6 to near neutral, the casein turns into a salt and dissolves, and the solution is dried to a soluble powder used as emulsifier and protein in foods.

steps.note: The curd at 25–30 % solids is milled to a slurry.

steps.name: neutralise
steps.note: With NaOH 2.5 M (10 %), 1.7–2.2 % of casein solids, or Ca(OH)₂, KOH or ammonia, to pH about 6.7.
Spray dried from a feed of 20–22 % solids to a powder below 5 % moisture.
